design: paths.path3.tiers.tier5: Resolved x-x-5 adds no new behavior or access over x-x-4 and carries no proposed mechanic. The fifth purchase of every path must add a supported behavior or access: a new delivery, a distinct-target volley of more than one projectile, more than one projectile, splash, a status effect, a bounded follow-up, a new damage type, a newly detected trait or new bonus damage against an eligible enemy property; larger existing numbers, the Active Ability's included, a targeting change, a new name or a change with no effect do not count. A proposed mechanic grants no behavior in any build: a purchase whose only new capability is proposed is an unresolved design gap, not playable until the Definition supports it.

paths.path3.tiers.tier5.planIntent: The retained plan promises improved burn, but this purchase does not implement it in legal build 0-0-5. Raise the status effect's magnitude or seconds in statuses. Keep the purchase's other promised changes; an unrelated benefit does not satisfy it.

paths.path3.tiers.tier5.planIntent: The retained plan promises unlock splash, but this purchase does not implement it in legal build 0-0-5. Add the capability at exactly this purchase. Keep the purchase's other promised changes; an unrelated benefit does not satisfy it.
